description: Complete SDR development and analysis environment with GNU Radio 3.10, 30+ OOT modules, SDR drivers, GUI apps (GQRX, SDR++, SDRAngel, CubicSDR, SatDump, SigDigger), decoders, cellular tools, digital modes, and trunking.
notes:
Based on kasmweb/core-ubuntu-noble:1.18.0. The kitchen-sink image with every SDR tool. For focused workspaces, see DragonOS - SDR Receivers, Aviation, Cellular, etc.

For USB SDR device access, the container runs privileged.
